Later in the war, Count Dooku and his agent, Minister [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo]], managed to bring [[Lyonie/Legends|Boss Lyonie]] under their control, alongside the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]]. Grievous soon arrived with with his troops to [[Skirmish on Naboo/Legends|attack]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] with the Gungans in support. After his [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|landing craft]] arrived on Naboo, Naboo Representative [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] (posing as Boss Lyonie), along with Gungan General [[Roos Tarpals/Legends|Roos Tarpals]] went to distract Grievous from launching his attack. At first Jar Jar was able to do this, but Grievous eventually saw through the trick and attempted to kill him. When the cyborg general chased Jar Jar out of the ship, Grievous saw that his droids had been deactivated and that an entire army of Gungans was waiting for him. Grievous refused the Gungans' offer of surrender and pulled out two of his lightsabers. Grievous then fought the Gungans, easily killing several them. When Tarpals attacked Grievous, the general fatally injured the aged Gungan by stabbing him in the chest. Unfortunately for the general, Tarpals, with the last of his strength, shocked Grievous into submission, enabling his capture. At first this was a success, but Dooku, at the behest of Darth Sidious, had trapped Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and contacted Senator Amidala to make a prisoner exchange. Thus Amidala gave Grievous up for Skywalker, and Grievous, restrained by Gungan technology was freed. Grievous and his force then left Naboo and war continued with him still in charge of the Confederate Droid Army.<ref name="Shadow Warrior">{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}</ref>

Shortly following the events on Naboo, General Grievous executed an [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|attack]] on Jedi Master [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia's]] flagship. Grievous defeated her after boarding the Star Destroyer, and took her prisoner. Shortly after, Grievous encountered a pirate warship nearby. As his gunners fired on it for target practice, Jedi Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] attacked Grievous' flagship, and rescued Master Gallia. Grievous escaped, though his flagship was lost.<ref name="Nomad Droids">{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}</ref>

====Battle of Dathomir====
{{Quote|Wipe the witches out. All of them.|[[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] ordering Grievous to attack the Nightsisters|<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref>}}
[[File:GrievousVsVentress-Massacre.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Grievous battles Ventress to force her army to surrender.]]
Grievous was then ordered by Count Dooku to wipe Ventress, [[Talzin/Legends|Mother Talzin]] and her fellow [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] out on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Grievous took a Separatist Fleet to Dathomir and landed his forces. Grievous commanded his forces from inside one of his landing ships. When his droids encountered fierce resistance on the eastern front. Therefore, Grievous decided to use [[Defoliator/Legends|Defoliator]] Tanks to burn the forest and wipe the witches out.

After Ventress, the Nightsisters, and an undead army disabled the Defoliators and AATs, Grievous stepped out of his landing ship and accepted Ventress's challenge to single combat. If Ventress defeated Grievous, he and his forces would leave Dathomir, but if Grievous won the Nightsisters would surrender. The two warriors fought each other with their lightsabers. At first, Grievous appeared to have the upper hand and toyed with Ventress, until she surprised him by severing one of his four mechanical arms and knocking him down. Having never intended to honor the terms of their duel, and no longer amused by it, Grievous, laughing, turned the tables on Ventress by ordering his droids to kill her. This time Ventress was knocked to the ground after taking a blast to the shoulder. However, unlike Grievous a few moments prior, who had been far from defenseless and was quickly able to stand and fight, Ventress was wounded and nearly helpless. Grievous towered over Ventress, ready to finish her off, but she was saved when the [[Army of the Dead/Legends|Army of the Dead]] rushed Grievous, forcing him to fend off dozens of undead warriors as they set upon him like a flood. While Grievous was distracted, cutting down wave after wave of reanimated Nightsisters, Ventress made her escape.

Grievous was then contacted by Count Dooku, who was being tortured by Mother Talzin's [[Dathomir Magic|magic]]. Dooku ordered Grievous to follow the magic's green mist to Talzin and kill her before she killed him. After finishing off his undead attackers, Grievous and his droids followed the trail of mist, tearing through the Nightsisters' battle lines, slaughtering anyone who stood in their way. Grievous and his droids entered [[Nightsister fortress|Talzin's village]], and traced the mist directly to the cave where Talzin and [[Daka/Legends|Old Daka]] were performing their spells. As Grievous entered, he coldly executed Talzin's Nightsister guards and Old Daka. As he was about to kill Talzin, she seemingly turned into a cloud green smoke and disappeared. Nevertheless, Grievous was able to stop Talzin's spell over the Count. The battle turned into a genocidal massacre and was a near complete success for the Confederacy. When the smoke cleared, Grievous had successfully exterminated the entire coven of Nightsisters and prevented the loss of Count Dooku in the process.<ref name="Massacre" />

At some later point, Dooku informed Grievous of [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and his growing power. While Grievous was quick to dismiss this and scoffed at the idea that Opress could be considered a threat, Dooku apparently thought otherwise, warning Grievous that Opress posed a danger to anyone who crossed his path or was somehow mixed up in his past, including themselves.<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref>

Despite his many victories, Grievous did also face several setbacks. His attempt to [[Mission to the Deyvus|capture]] Anakin Skywalker on the starship ''Deyvus'' failed,<ref name="Terror on the Twilight">{{TCWComicCite|6.5|Terror on the Twilight|Terror on the ''Twilight''}}</ref> as did an [[Battle of the Gyndine moon|attack]] on the Gyndine Moon.<ref name="The Fear Architects">{{TCWComicCite|6.32|The Fear Architects}}</ref>

====Invasion of Florrum====
[[File:GrievousOnFlorrum.png|thumb|left|250px|Grievous with two of his bodyguards on Florrum, right before the battle]]
After forcing Obi-Wan Kenobi's remaining forces into a retreat after destroying a task group of Star Destroyers, Grievous next set his sights on the [[Florrum system/Legends|Florrum system]], which he successfully conquered. Following orders from Dooku, Grievous and his forces landed on the [[Florrum/Legends|system's namesake]] planet where the infamous pirate, [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], and his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]] resided. Grievous forcibly took Ohnaka's [[Hondo's complex/Legends|base]] as retribution for previously holding Dooku to ransom. Unbeknownst to Grievous, however, several of Ohnaka's men had been dispatched earlier to capture Jedi Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and six Jedi [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]]. With the threat of Grievous standing before them, the pirates and Jedi agreed to a temporary alliance. Together they managed to free Ohnaka from captivity and hastily made their way towards the pirate captain's secret cache of stolen and foraged [[Starship/Legends|starships]], with Grievous in close pursuit. In the midst of the chase, Tano and some of the younglings were separated from their group and confronted by Grievous. As the general cornered his prey, Ohnaka and the others arrived on the scene with a [[Slave I/Legends|red and green Firespray starship]]. The younglings managed to board the ship while Tano kept Grievous occupied in a heated duel. Although the Padawan proved herself to be a much more formidable foe than she was during her [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|first encounter with the general]], she was still hopelessly outmatched. However, Tano survived long enough to ensure the younglings' safety and narrowly escaped Grievous to join them aboard the starship. Ohnaka used the ship's guns to fire on Grievous but the general was saved by the timely intervention of several [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AAT's]] which forced Ohnaka and the Jedi to flee.<ref name="A Necessary Bond">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref>

Grievous and his forces demolished Ohnaka's base and left Florrum at some point afterwards.<ref name="Revival">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>

====Victorious on all fronts====
{{Quote|So, the Republic would have the galaxy believe that its heart is secure. Today's events, however, show that there is nothing that can stop our forces from total victory.|Grievous, referring to the invasion of Duro by the Confederacy|<ref name="Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:3:02">{{InsiderCite|75|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:3:02}}</ref>}}
[[File:75GeneralGrievousFinal.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Grievous following the conquest of Duro.]]
Grievous led the CIS to victories on [[Banvhar Station]] and [[Vandos]],<ref name="General Grievous 1">[[General Grievous 1|''General Grievous'' 1]]</ref> among numerous other battles.{{Fact}} In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Parein II 4 date">"[[The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War]]" places the Battle of Parein II 4 a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] into the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which corresponds to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Grievous debuted his customized [[Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike]]<ref name="Lord of War" /> and his Magnaguards<ref name="Sony MagnaGuards">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68375&month=072009|text=Friday Feature – Game Update 12 -- Engineering Trader}}</ref> in the [[Battle of Parein II 4/Legends|Battle of Parein II 4]]. The general led a successful charge on the surface of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Parein II 4/Legends|Parein II 4]] which crushed the Republic forces led by Jedi General [[Sannen/Legends|Sannen]] and Jedi [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tyneir Renz]].<ref name="Lord of War" /> Sannen attempted to aprehend Grievous during the battle, but was jabbed in the throat by a MagnaGuard<ref name="NEGD" /> and killed.<ref name="Sony MagnaGuards" /> Impressed with the combat effectiveness of his wheel bike, Grievous commissioned several more for his MagnaGuards.<ref name="Lord of War" />

Grievous also helped convince the skilled [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] warriors to [[Battle of Togoria (Clone Wars)|defect]] to the Confederacy. When the Republic, led by General [[Waldan Bridger]], arrived at Togoria, they were attacked by the people, who wished to remain with the CIS. Grievous challenged Bridger to a duel, killing him in seconds, and kept the planet from the Republic.<ref name="NEC" /> However, the general was not invincible. The reinforcements he sent Rendili Separatists during the [[Battle of Rendili]] were defeated by the combined forces of the Republic and the Rendili Fleet. He also failed to destroy the mines on [[Viidaav]] during [[Battle of Viidaav|one battle]],<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides (comic)">{{CWACite|5|Heroes on Both Sides (comic story)}}</ref> and had a number of other defeats throughout the war.

Months later, Grievous put into motion [[Operation Durge's Lance]], a major Separatist campaign whose goal was the complete conquest of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Hundreds of planets along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] fell before his forces, including the major world of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]<ref name="The Story of General Grievous" /> whose defeat Grievous personally supervised, and forced a public surrender from [[Hoolidan Keggle]] in a galaxy-wide HoloNet transmission. Grievous was also responsible for the hour-long [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the heavily populated and urbanized planet [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]], one of the [[Core Founder/Legends|founding members]] of the Galactic Republic, which resulted in the fragmentation of the planet's crust.<ref name="RotS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> During the [[Battle of Loedorvia]], he released the [[Brainrot Plague|Loedorvian Brain Plague]] into the [[Weemell sector/Legends|Weemell sector]], which destroyed Republic armies and nearly all [[Human/Legends|Humans]] on [[Loedorvia|the planet]].<ref name="OEG:S1" /> Due to these acts of wanton destruction, Grievous soon became an avatar of terror in the eyes of the citizens of the Republic, as he won battle after battle.<ref name="The Story of General Grievous" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Grievous baited the Republic forces to Vandos by kidnapping [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Quiyyen]]. Jedi Knights T'chooka D'oon and Jmmaar sent to [[Rescue mission to Vandos|rescue]] Quiyyen were killed in the assault, though the Republic was successful in securing the ambassador. T'chooka's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Flynn Kybo]], was infuriated by this, and, desperate for revenge, gathered a group of other Jedi, including B'dard Tone and [[Codi Ty]], to take revenge on Grievous, something the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] disapproved of. During their hunt for him, Grievous [[Capture of the Mon Calamari ship|captured]] a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] ship, and killed Jedi Master [[Quarmall]] and captured several of his [[Bergruutfa Clan|younglings]] aboard.<ref name="General Grievous 1" /> He planned to use them as Human-droid hybrids, with an exoskeleton droid suit, similar to himself. After Grievous [[Battle of Gentes|conquered]] [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]], several [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] released by the group of Jedi led by Kybo, located him on [[Belsus/Legends|Belsus]]. The Jedi were now determined to rescue the younglings and Padawans he was holding hostage, having learned of them with help from the slicer [[Rini]]. Though the probe droids attacked him, the cyborg had no trouble destroying them, and thus nothing was accomplished besides alerting their interest in him to the general.<ref name="General Grievous 2">[[General Grievous 2|''General Grievous'' 2]]</ref> With help from an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]], the Padawans escaped, but Grievous pursued them.<ref name="General Grievous 3">[[General Grievous 3|''General Grievous'' 3]]</ref> He confronted them, but at that moment the Jedi arrived. While Codi led them to safety, Grievous dueled B'dard and Flynn, killing them both after Kybo cut open a gas line, causing a large explosion.<ref name="General Grievous 4">[[General Grievous 4|''General Grievous'' 4]]</ref>

===Battling against the Underworld===
====Fighting a new adversary====
{{Quote|You should have '''killed''' Maul when you had him in your custody. I told you he was '''too dangerous''' to let live.|Grievous stating his views on Maul's escape|<ref name="Son of Dathomir 1">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 1|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 1]]</ref>}}
Grievous was contacted by his master Dooku about the recently escaped [[Maul|Darth Maul]] from Sidious's custody and was told to direct his droid fleet to the planet [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]] in order to confront the Sith Lord. Grievous berated Dooku for going along with the plan of just letting Maul live instead of just execute him like he had suggested, the Count reminded his apprentice to not question Sidious's actions and to not kill Maul once he found him, for the real ploy behind this attack was to force Maul to ask for help, specifically for Mother Talzin, who Palpatine saw as a potential thread to his plans. Grievous complied and deployed several of his starfighters and his whole infantry on the surface of Zanbar, ready to [[Battle of Zanbar/Legends|attack]] the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]]'s secret base.<ref name="Son of Dathomir 1" />

[[File:DarthMaulGrievousDuel.png|thumb|right|230px|Maul and Grievous engage in a duel.]]
Grievous was wary of Maul's forces as unlike the regular clone troopers they usually fought against, [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors were considerably more dangerous and unpredictable, to the point the general was convinced the odds were stacked against them. Eventually Grievous himself decided to join the battle, taunting Maul about his coming demise, not before sending some of his bodyguards to tire the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] out, while Maul was fighting the droids, Grievous came down and took sadistic pleasure while killing some of the Mandalorians present, he was soon engaged by an enraged Maul, Grievous laughed at Mauls efforts as he pointed out how his droids had all but crushed his Mandalorian forces and that the battle was essentially over. Maul then called for his [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport|Gauntlet starfighters]] to enter the fight, the ships then proceeded to bombard the entire battlefield and retrieve their leader. While Grievous survived he found his forces had been depleted as well. Grievous received a hologram call from Dooku once again and relied his success in making Maul bleed, but laments his heavy loses, the Count assured him they had been acceptable loses and confirmed that the real target they were looking for had been Mother Talzin al along, saying Maul mustn't suspect of their true intentions.<ref name="Son of Dathomir 1" />

====Imprisonment and escape====
{{Quote|Those of you who can still stand -- return to your master... '''And tell him to send more men!'''|Grievous while escaping|<ref name="Son of Dathomir 3">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 3|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 3]]</ref>}}
At the same time Maul was rallying support against his pursuing foes, Grievous spies had managed to recover information regarding Mandalorian warships amassing on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], all but confirming [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]'s involvement in the whole operation. Dooku dismissed the option launching a strike against Maul's building army, since they still didn't know Talzin's current location. Grievous inquired why was a simple witch of such interest to the CIS operations. Sidious's apprentice warned Grievous to not underestimate Talzin as her vast array of abilities were so formidable his master had sought them himself which is why the became allies and that now that she had become an enemy, she also presented a mighty thread to Sith's plans. The separatists managed to detect a vessel coming out of Dathomir, which they assumed had Talzin on it.<ref name="Son of Dathomir 2">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 2|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 2]]</ref>

[[File:CIS_Orbital_Bombardment_SoD.png|thumb|left|230px|Grievous ordered for his ships to fire.]]
After arriving at Ord Mantell, Grievous [[Battle on Ord Mantell/Legends|immediately ordered]] his fleet to fire their lasers, unleashing an onslaught of fire on the planet's surface. Grievous followed his plans deploying troops on the ruined city at the same time Dooku landed as well along some MagnaGuards in order to search for Maul and Talzin inside the ruins. Grievous started sensing that something was amiss, as all the warships that made them set course for the planet in the first place were mysteriously nowhere to be seen. [[Tey-Zuka/Legends|Tey-Zuka]] tried to calm his liege, assuring him the ships had most likely been destroyed on the initial bombardment, it wasn't long before Grievous concerns where validated and the whole CIS cruiser was attacked by those very same Mandalorian aircrafts. Out of nowhere Maul then boarded Grievous ship's destroyed almost every droid in his command room using the force and demanded the general could either disconnect the droids's command line, die, or both. Grievous was forced to choose the former and essentially disabled his own army, which also caused Dooku to be captured as well.<ref name="Son of Dathomir 2" />

Shortly after being captured, Maul tried to use both Dooku and Grievous as a bargaining chip against his former master, Sidious however refused to listen to any of either Maul's or Mother Talzin's demands and said that he could just killed both of them as he had no more use for any of them. Maul then ordered Grievous to be sent into the brig and receive constant monitoring in case to prevent any escape attempts. Grievous was led away, warning his master he did not want to have to add his lightsaber to his collection. Later on Dooku used to force to open the locks on the door of Grievous's cell, allowing the Cyborg to escape, Grievous managed to find an escape pod and go back to Sidious to rely to him the information of what had happened not before brutally killing several [[Mandalorian shock trooper|Mandalorian Commandos]] with his bare hands and feet, telling them they should've called for reinforcements.<ref name="Son of Dathomir 3" />

====Finishing off Talzin====
{{Quote|It's time|Grievous right before murdering Talzin|<ref name="Son of Dathomir 4">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 4|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 4]]</ref>}}
[[File:Grievous_Owns_Talzin.png|thumb|right|225px|Grievous executes Talzin.]]
Following Sidious's instructions, Grievous and his droids were able to track Dooku's signal to Dathomir aboard the ''[[Scimitar/Legends|Scimitar]]''. Sidious told the general to activate the cloaking device on the ship. Claiming their enemies wouldn't even know of their presence until it was far too late. Grievous and Sidious landed on the planet and approached an extrange chamber said to hold Mother Talzin's powers to an extend. Grievous violently blown up the main entrance's door and announced Maul's and his allies' blood was about to spill. Having arrived right after Maul had performed a ritual to allow Talzin to possess Dooku's body, Grievous started dueling Maul alone once again, while Sidious fought his possessed apprentice, while the Sith lord as easily able to defeat Talzin, Grievous struggled against Maul who ended up force pushing him outside the building through the giant hole he had made. Grievous had to take some time to get back into the fight but survived nonetheless.<ref name="Son of Dathomir 4" />

Grievous was able to climb back into the chamber and saw the struggle between the reborn Talzin and both of the Sith Lords. Talzin threw Maul back into one of his ships so he could escape while she delayed the separatists from killing him. Grievous then wielded both of his lightsaber, effortlessly walked through the force field Talzin had created, and impaled her through the chest, killing her once and for all and fulfilling his mission of wiping out the night sisters from years ago. Grievous had his droids take hold over the planet and repel the rest of the Shadow Collective's forces, gaining a significat victory for the separatists.<ref name="Son of Dathomir 4" />

===Foes new and old===
[[File:TheDeathofSoonBaytes.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Grievous easily defeats Soon Bayts on Boz Pity.]]
At some point, Grievous proposed that the Confederacy increase its use of bioweapons in attacks on worlds in the Outer Rim, after seeing the results of the devastation caused by them during the [[Battle of Honoghr/Legends|Battle of Honoghr]]. He sent pictures of [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]] taken six months after the battle to [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] to be reviewed by Dooku. After Dooku was [[Mission to Vjun (Clone Wars)|forced]] to leave Vjun, Grievous scheduled a meeting with him.<ref name="Yoda">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref> Several months later, on [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]], Grievous [[Battle of Boz Pity (Clone Wars)|led]] a droid army in opposition to Jedi-led Republic forces that had arrived there. The cyborg general dueled Jedi Master [[Soon Bayts]], surprising the Jedi and crushing his head in his claws before Bayts had time to raise his lightsaber. Grievous then took his lightsaber, using it to combat the clone troopers.<ref name="Obsession 4">[[Obsession 4|''Obsession'' 4]]</ref> Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] arrived at this moment, and, using the Force, smashed a [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAP]] on top of him. Grievous was knocked unconscious but was later rescued by his bodyguards, who took him to escape the planet with Count Dooku.<ref name="Obsession 5">[[Obsession 5|''Obsession'' 5]]</ref>

[[File:TamborGrievous.jpg|thumb|right|210px|Grievous with Wat Tambor, around the time of the Battle of Xagobah.]]
During the [[Second Battle of Xagobah|Battle of Xagobah]], Grievous confronted the young bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who was on one of his first missions. After the Republic attacked [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor's]] [[Mazariyan|fortress]], Fett had taken advantage of the chaos to try and collect on a bounty placed on Tambor's head by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. He infiltrated the fortress and attacked Tambor, who shot back at him, and called Grievous to help him. The general left the main battle and entered Tambor's private room, where he attacked Fett, despite the young clone pretending to be Durge with the help of a [[Multispectrum disguise suite|holoshroud]]. He easily defeated the boy and almost killed him, as Fett survived only by faking death. Grievous then retreated from the planet with Wat Tambor and Asajj Ventress before the Republic's clone troopers burst through the citadel.<ref name="A New Threat">''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]''</ref>

Grievous' hatred of Nute Gunray intensified after several incidents. First, the Viceroy insisted on going back to [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] to recover some of his valuables, allowing Republic forces to follow him to a meeting place, where Grievous was forced to kill the clone pilots pursuing the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]]'s ship to save Gunray, though he would have preferred to let them capture the Neimoidian, and allowed them to inflict minor damage on Gunray's shuttle before destroying his pursuers. Later, Gunray lost his [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechno-chair]], allowing the Republic to learn that Grievous intended to capture [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]]. Grievous led the Separatist fleet into an ambush by a group of Republic warships there before ultimately fleeing. Though he killed 27 Jedi in the ensuing battle, Grievous was furious at someone for allowing the Republic to learn of this, and he suspected Gunray was to blame. He confronted Gunray, who revealed that the Republic must have found his mechno-chair after he had left it on Cato Neimoidia by accident. Grievous threatened him, but stopped short of actually physically harming him.<ref name="LOE" />

===Endgame===
{{Quote|You're mine, old man!|Grievous upon capturing Supreme Chancellor Palpatine during the Battle of Coruscant|<ref name="Chapter 25">{{CW|25}}</ref>}}
[[File:CW_Chapter_24.png|thumb|left|220px|Grievous stalked behind Shaak Ti on Coruscant.]]
After learning that the Jedi were onto him, thanks in part to the recordings discovered from the mechno-chair, Darth Sidious, who was actually Chancellor Palpatine, informed Grievous that he had a special mission—to [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|invade]] Coruscant and kidnap the Chancellor.<ref name="LOE" /> Grievous was on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], leading the Separatists in the opening stages of [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|the battle]] there,<ref name="RepCommando">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref> but left for Coruscant.<ref name="Order66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> Grievous led the Confederacy starfleet in an all-out attack on the Republic capital, using secret hyperspace routes given to him by Sidious. During the battle, Grievous ordered diversionary tactics, such as sending suicide squadrons of Vulture droids to cause chaos in the city and to terrorize the citizens. While a massive battle raged between Separatist and Republic forces, Grievous led an assault on [[500 Republica/Legends|''500 Republica'']] with intelligence provided by Darth Sidious.<ref name="LOE" /> During Grievous' search for Palpatine on the surface, he was soon discovered by [[X2]], a Force-sensitive clone serving the Republic, and was followed to a [[Skylane/Legends|skylane]] [[transport/Legends|transportation]] hub. There, Grievous encountered X2 in battle, and the two fought each other, but he was unable to defeat the clone, utilizing explosives against him, hurling him into traffic and injuring him. Faced with a challenging enemy, Grievous had to applaud X2 for staying longer against him than expected and decided to retreat and continue his mission.<ref name="EliteSquadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>

The Jedi, commanded by Shaak Ti, took Palpatine to a secret bunker aboard a [[Hovertrain/Legends|maglev train]]; however, Grievous and his MagnaGuards caught up with them and dueled the Jedi Mace Windu and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] on top of the train. In spite of facing one of the most formidable Jedi, Grievous managed to be Windu's equal in skill even though the Korun master utilized a unique variant of Form VII unfamiliar to the cyborg. The duel ended with Grievous being pushed off the train, although he was saved by a hijacked LAAT/i gunship, unknown to the Jedi. Grievous reached the hardened bunker with six of his MagnaGuards in tow, and accessed it using codes provided by Darth Sidious. Cutting a bloody path of destruction through the bunker, he made his way to Palpatine. He quickly killed four of Palpatine's Jedi protectors: [[Roron Corobb/Legends|Roron Corobb]], [[Foul Moudama]], [[Roth-Del Masona]], and [[B'ink Utrila]], as well as a number of clone troopers before kidnapping the Chancellor. With no threat to him, Grievous threatened Palpatine, who rebuked that he wasn't afraid of the Separatist General. Palpatine asserted that Grievous wouldn't dare harm him and inquired what his masters' would say if any harm came to him. Grievous told Palpatine that he was lucky they wanted him alive, not realizing that Palpatine was one of them. He then dueled Shaak Ti and spared her to inform the Jedi that the Chancellor was gone.<ref name="LOE" /> As he fled, Jedi Master Mace Windu [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Crush|Force crushed]] the plates covering Grievous's internal organ sac,<ref name="Chapter 25" /> causing the duranium steel to cut his lungs,<ref name="The Story of General Grievous" /> which aggravated the General's<ref name="Chapter 25" /> already irritating<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> wheezing and coughing problems;<ref name="Chapter 25" /> a result of his organic form not taking well to his cyborg implants.<ref name="DVD">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith#DVD release|''Star Wars:'' Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' DVD commentary]]</ref> This crippling blow injured Grievous for the rest of his life—which would not be long.<ref name="Chapter 25" /><ref name="ROTS" />

[[File:Grievous_on_Invisible_Hand.png|thumb|right|230px|Grievous aboard the ''Invisible Hand''.]]
Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi, fresh from a [[Recapture of Tythe|victory]] on [[Tythe/Legends|Tythe]],<ref name="LOE" /> got wind of what had happened and set off to rescue Palpatine. After fighting their way through the massive battle, the Jedi boarded the ''Invisible Hand'', killed Dooku, and escaped with the Supreme Chancellor, not knowing that they had walked into an elaborate trap. The two Jedi were soon entrapped in a [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] and surrounded by droids who brought them before Grievous on the ''Invisible Hand''{{'s}} bridge. As Grievous gloated, the Jedi managed to un-cuff themselves while R2-D2 provided a distraction. Skywalker and Kenobi then swiftly defeated Grievous's IG-100 MagnaGuards. In an attempt to escape the deteriorating ship and leave the Jedi to die, Grievous shattered the front window of the cruiser with the [[IG-102/Legends|IG-102's]] [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]]. Kenobi, Skywalker, and the Chancellor managed to stay in the ship, but Grievous was sucked into space. Protected from exposure to vacuum, the general survived and used a grappling hook installed in his arm to latch onto the hull of the ship.<ref name="ROTS" />

Grievous fled in one of his flagship's [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], which was later picked up by a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]. In fact, he had every single escape pod launched, leaving the Jedi and Palpatine stranded aboard the collapsing ''Invisible Hand''; yet Skywalker used all his skill to bring half the ship down the planet's surface for a safe landing. Realizing that his objective had failed, the cyborg general and his fleet retreated. Grievous boarded his [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]] and headed for the secured planet of Utapau in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], where the Separatist Council was hiding.<ref name="ROTS" /> He had previously used Utapau as a base as early as 21 BBY,<ref name="TripleZero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> but unbeknownst to him, he was being monitored there by [[Clone Intelligence/Legends|Clone Intelligence]] units. Now that Grievous was there again, the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]]s [[Kom'rk Skirata|N-6]] and [[Jaing Skirata|N-10]] reported this, and Grievous's presence on Utapau became known by the Republic.<ref name="Order66" />

With Count Dooku's death, Grievous succeeded him as Head of State of the Confederacy of Independent Systems - thus making him both political and military leader of the Separatists. Under the direct order of Dooku's Master, Darth Sidious, Grievous was to relocate the Council to the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] while he stayed on Utapau, waiting for the arrival of Kenobi, of which he had been warned by Sidious. When receiving his orders, he briefly protested when learning that the Clone Wars were going to end soon and that the Separatists would most likely lose due to Dooku's loss, although Sidious reassured him that the former Separatist leader's loss was "necessary". The Sith Lord would soon have a new apprentice: "one far younger and more powerful."<ref name="ROTS" />

====Return to Utapau and duel with Kenobi====
{{Quote|Back away! I will deal with this Jedi slime myself!|General Grievous|<ref name="ROTS" />}}
After the Republic received word that Grievous was hiding on Utapau, General Kenobi was sent to [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|defeat]] him. Though Nute Gunray and the other Council members doubted Grievous' ability to lead, they followed his orders, leaving just moments before Kenobi's arrival. Amused by his nemesis's brazen entrance, the cyborg ordered for his four MagnaGuards to go in for the kill, only for Kenobi to dispatch three of them with the Force, then finish off the trapped fourth with a casual decapitation.<ref name="ROTS" />

[[File:Kenobi_faces_Grievous_ROTS.png|thumb|left|264px|Obi-Wan Kenobi faces General Grievous for the last time.]]
Still weak and injured from his encounter with Windu, Grievous immediately split his arms in four and attacked Kenobi, also ordering the other droids present to not interfere on his behalf, as he wanted to deal with the Jedi personally. During the duel, however,<ref name="ROTS" /> his inability to penetrate Kenobi's [[Form III/Legends|Form III]] defense, even when attacking him at a rate of twenty strikes per second,<ref name="ROTSn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'' Episode III: ''Revenge of the Sith'' novel]]</ref> made his offense grow sloppy. Kenobi took advantage of this and altered the angle of his parries to sever Grievous' wrists. Grievous lost two of his hands to Kenobi before [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] arrived, ambushing the droid army. Fighting broke out all over Pau City between droid and clone forces.<ref name="ROTS" />

Grievous was undaunted by this turn of events. Possibly drawing upon Sidious's promises of victory, he taunted Kenobi one final time: even with the assistance of their clone forces, the Jedi Master and every one of his breathren were going to fall. But Kenobi responsed with a powerful Force push, sending Grievous up onto a wall, knocking his remaining lightsabers off his hands. In a spider-like fashion, Greivous reached his [[Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike|wheel bike]] and tried to run Kenobi over and, failing that, fled. Commander Cody recovered the weapon and reported the state of the battle back to the Jedi Council's meeting in the [[Temple's war room/Legends|war room]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant, letting them know that Kenobi had tracked down and confronted the cyborg general on Utapau. Mace Windu then had Anakin Skywalker deliver the news to the Chancellor to wait for his reaction that might give them a hint about his plans.<ref name="ROTS" />

====Death====
{{Listen|filename=GrievousDeath.flac|title=The Death of General Grievous|description=Listen to Grievous's death cry}}
[[File:GrievousHeartburn.jpg|thumb|right|215px|Grievous is shot in his synthskin gut-sack by Obi-Wan Kenobi on Utapau.]]
Pursued by Kenobi on a [[Varactyl/Legends|varactyl]] named [[Boga/Legends|Boga]], after a prolonged chase and running duel, the two crashed onto Grievous' private landing platform where his personal, customized starfighter, the ''Soulless One'', was docked. As they fought hand-to-hand, Grievous made use of his mechanical body and superior strength, although Kenobi managed to rip open Grievous' previously damaged chest plates, revealing the synthskin gut-sack containing his remaining organs. Angered, Grievous tossed Kenobi off the platform, but the Jedi managed to catch hold of the edge. Grievous, deprived of most of his arsenal, picked up the electrostaff and charged at Kenobi, raising the staff to finish him off. Before he could deliver the killing blow, however, Kenobi used the Force to summon Grievous's personal<ref name="ROTS" /> modified [[DT-57 "Annihilator" blaster/Legends|DT-57 blaster]],<ref name="The Story of General Grievous" /> the [[Grievance Striker/Legends|Grievance Striker]],<ref name="SWG:GS">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=item|Grievance Striker}}</ref> to his outstretched hand. He fired five bolts between the gap in Grievous' chest plate into the general's gut-sack. The oils preserving Grievous' remaining biological components ignited, incinerating the famed cyborg from the inside and destroying him.<ref name="ROTS" />

Obi-Wan held the blaster ready and watched as further explosions rattled the cyborg general's metal casing.<ref name="ROTSnj">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' junior novelization]]</ref> A fooling-smelling spray the colour of a rotting marsh burst from his guts. Energy raced up his spine, and a mist of evaporated brain erupted from both sides of his skull and spun his face out of control.<ref name="ROTSn" /> With flames bursting from his eye slits,<ref name="ROTS" /> Grievous finally died the horrific warrior's death he so desperately longed for since the day he lost his [[Soul/Legends|soul]] to the Jenuwaa Sea,<ref name="The Story of General Grievous" /> and collapsed in a smoking heap. Obi-Wan used the Force to sense for any sign of life left, but he discovered none. With a sigh of relief, he made his way back to the tunnel to retrieve his mount.<ref name="ROTSnj" /> His droid form was abandoned on Utapau,<ref name="CSWE" /> where it served as the general's last resting place, final, that is, until his metal corpse would be dug up for scientific purposes.<ref name="Lord of War" /> Palpatine accepted that the Clone Wars had ended with the destruction of General Grievous. However, he was surprised that the four Jedi—Mace Windu, [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], Kit Fisto, and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]]—had [[Showdown on Coruscant|stormed into his private office]] sooner than planned, allowing him to submit and abandon the Senate's unique powers.<ref name="ROTS" />

===Legacy===
Shortly after Grievous' death, Darth Sidious used his alter ego Supreme Chancellor Palpatine to [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|execute]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and nearly all of the Jedi were eliminated. After his own clone troopers turned upon him,<ref name="ROTS" /> Kenobi followed the footprints a short distance around a curve till the tunnel gave out to the small landing platform<ref name="ROTSn" /> of his last battle with Grievous, where Grievous's starfighter, the ''Soulless One'', and his remains were still present<ref name="ROTS" /> and apparently unaffected by local [[Rock-vulture/Legends|rock-vultures]].<ref name="ROTSn" /> Obi-Wan retreated from Utapau aboard the starfighter,<ref name="ROTS" /> roaring out of the atmosphere so quickly, he popped the gravity well and made a leap before the ''[[Vigilance (Venator-class)/Legends|Vigilance]]'' could even scramble its fighters.<ref name="ROTSn" /> He met up with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] aboard the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Alderaanian]]'s [[CR-series/Legends|diplomatic ship]] [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Tantive III'']]. Sidious then ordered his newly recruited apprentice, Anakin Skywalker, now known as Darth Vader, to [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|eliminate]] Nute Gunray and the rest of the Separatist Council gathering on Mustafar, effectively bringing the Clone Wars to an end.<ref name="ROTS" />

[[File:DarthVaderBust-TESB.png|thumb|left|230px|The Geonosisian technology that earlier saved General Grievous was greatly enhanced in the reconstruction of Anakin Skywalker's broken body into the black-armored Darth Vader.]]
The Geonosian technology was considerably improved and utilized to reconstruct Anakin Skywalker's shattered body into the [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|black-armored]] Darth Vader.<ref name="The Story of General Grievous" /> After his [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|duel]] with Obi-Wan Kenobi on Mustafar, Vader was transported to Coruscant and underwent reconstructive surgery from various droids,<ref name="ROTS" /> including [[FX-6/Legends|FX-6]],<ref name="ROTS:TVD" /> some of which had observed General Grievous's cyborg transformation on Geonosis a decade earlier,<ref name="Dark Lord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> repaired his amputated limbs with cybernetic ones, and encased his incinerated body in a [[Life support/Legends|life-support]] suit.<ref name="ROTS" />

In some way, Darth Vader resembled something taken from the Separatists, a hideous union of humanoid and machine, a sort of black-armored version of Grievous but more dangerous and apparently responsible for carrying out Palpatine's dirty work. Vader reflected on the possibility that the promise of apprenticeship had always been a ruse, when, in reality, Sidious only needed another Grievous to lead his army of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], while he enjoyed the true benefits of power, certain that his newest subordinate would not challenge his authority.<ref name="Dark Lord" />

Grievous's starfighter, the ''Soulless One'', remained in the ''Tantive III''{{'s}} hangar until Kenobi flew it to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] with his infant passenger, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="The Story of General Grievous" /> Once there, Kenobi found a place called [[Paolo's Chop Shop]] and met a Kaleesh [[Technician/Legends|technician]] named [[Ishtah]], and despite having never personally observed one unmasked or in their entirety, he immediately recognized the species from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Jedi Archives/Legends|archives]]. As Ishtah examined the Jedi from hood to boots and back up again, Obi-Wan stared into those menacing split-pupils. The familiar sneer pierced Obi-Wan and recalled him of the shrieking flames from Grievous' eye sockets when he destroyed the cyborg's life-sustaining innards.<ref name="Lone Wolf">{{StoryCite|story=Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke|book=SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story}}</ref> Then, Kenobi sold the starfighter<ref name="The Story of General Grievous" /> to the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] shop owner [[Zegundis]]<ref name="Lone Wolf" /> for himself and the infant Skywalker to transport to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], as well as to give the child's new caregivers credit. Obi-Wan's cyborg acquaintance and an enemy eventually tracked down the ''Soulless One'' and reported it to the local Imperial authorities in an anonymous manner.<ref name="The Story of General Grievous" />

[[File:Skar.png|thumb|right|200px|Bentilais san Sk'ar was the only Izvoshra member to survive the shuttle crash.]]
The Izvoshra were believed to have perished in the shuttle crash,<ref name="CSWE" /> and Bentilais san Sk'ar, a former revolutionary who became a tyrant of the western Hemisphere, was the only member to survive the crash and rallied the Kolkpravis. Sk'ar led the [[slaughter of the Yam'rii]] on [[Oben]] and moved [[Kaleesh Resistance|his people]] to that resource-rich world.<ref name="gaw" /> He was created in the image of the renowned Kaleesh Qymaen jai Sheelal and recognized brilliant strategy whether he saw it. Over a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] after the Clone Wars, his planet had violently opposed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] dominion. After an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] failed to understand the Kaleesh art,<ref name="aite">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/97/indexp4.html|series=Aliens in the Empire|text=Part 2: To a Traitor Go the Spoils}}</ref> [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] Captain [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was compelled to destroy Oben as part of his [[Kaleesh–Imperial conflict|pacification]] of the fringe territories<ref name="gaw" /> and leveled his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] fleet. Sk'ar surrendered and offered his services or life and left Kalee space to serve the Empire as the Kaleesh Imperial general.<ref name="aite" />

===A partial rebirth===
{{Main|N-K Necrosis}}
[[File:Necrosis1.jpg|thumb|left|210px|N-K Necrosis was created from the body of the late General Grievous.]]
Following the execution of Order 66, Imperial clone troopers were<ref name="Lord of War" /> later<ref name="CSWE" /> ordered to<ref name="Lord of War" /> exhume<ref name="CSWE" /> and recover Grievous's lifeless body. Although mostly intact, it lacks the brain tissue that makes it conscious. Grievous' body has been stored alongside his captured starfighter to one of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine's secret storehouses on Utapau. Years later,<ref name="Lord of War" /> during the early years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]],<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Cyberneticist/Legends|cyberneticist]] Doctor [[Nycolai Kinesworthy]]<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> was hired by the Empire to advanced combat droid technologies and named his [[N-K Project|project "N-K,"]] a reference to his own name. Kinesworthy established business in the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] of [[Kashyyyk]] under the watchful eye of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Prophetess]], and an unconventional [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and total lunatic [[Treun Lorn]] was quickly recruited by Merili to assist with the development of a new battle droid<ref name="Lord of War" /> based on Grievous' mechanical exoskeleton. Merili was hired by Kinesworthy and Treun to retrieve Grievous' body from Utapau<ref name="CSWE" /> and led the two scientists to the secret storehouse on Utapau, where Grievous' body was obtained to host Kinesworthy's experimental [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]].<ref name="Lord of War" /> Grievous' mechanical exoskeleton served as an inspiration for the N-K series, and just only one droid was ever constructed.<ref name="CSWE" /> Lorn named the advanced combat droid [[N-K Necrosis|N-K 'Necrosis']], and continued the project on Kashyyyk.<ref name="Lord of War" />

N-K Necrosis begin his lifeless existence within Grievous' dead droid body. With the captured IG-100 MagnaGuards, now renamed [[NK-3]]s, Kinesworthy trained the new droid brain possessing Grievous' reanimated corpse how to use the exact lightsaber forms that the Separatist general had instructed them to use. Necrosis became a powerful and intelligent fighting machine as his predecessor had been, designed with Kinesworthy's sophisticated programming that give him both strength and a unique ability to think carefully about his action. N-K questioned if he was truly superior to Grievous or merely an empty form that once belonged to him. The droid pieced together information from his creator to determine who Grievous really was and felt something like envy for the sentient mind that once lived in its body, but the knowledge also brought on a sense of happiness. Necrosis pondered whether he was indeed more than a droid, alive, or perhaps Grievous's reincarnation.<ref name="Lord of War" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Treun Lorn kidnapped N-K Necrosis and his NK-3 bodyguards for his own purposes and kept them deep within the Myyydril Caverns.<ref name="SWG:RotW" />

Ultimately, the droid's such theoretical reflections were short-lived.<ref name="Lord of War" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> a motley band of<ref name="Lord of War" /> [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] invaded the Myyydril Caverns,<ref name="Lord of War" /> uncovered Kinesworthy's lab,<ref name="CSWE" /> and destroyed Necrosis and his NK-3 training droids. The avaricious group plundered the droid's remains, taking his blaster, [[Bane's Heart (crystal)|Bane's Heart]], and even dismantling Necrosis for its valuable components.<ref name="Lord of War" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] and Imperial [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]]<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 63">[[Star Wars (1977) 63|''Star Wars'' (1977) 63]]</ref> was rescued<ref name="TEP">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref> from the [[Battle of the secret armada|TIE fighter incident]],<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 63" /> recovered from her grievous injuries,<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> and secretly refashioned into Darth Vader's image using similar technology by the Empire's best bio-scientists,<ref name="The Story of General Grievous" /> transforming into a cyborg warrior known as the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]], Lumiya.<ref name="lumiyadatabank">{{DB|character|lumiya|Lumiya}}</ref> Almost certainly, the galaxy has witnessed the last of such raged-filled cyborg monstrosities.<ref name="The Story of General Grievous" />

[[File:Utapau_Surrenders.png|thumb|right|200px|''Utapau Surrenders'']]
